name: Address Decoupled
description: Provides the decoupled functionality for the address module.
project_description:
The Address decoupled module is an API expose for the Address module.

The module consists of a service (address_decoupled) that connects to the CommerceGuys addressing repositories for building an address format via API, validating any address, listing all the available countries, and saving an address to an entity. It ships five REST resource plugins (rest module resources) under the base path /address-decoupled/api/*, each returning JSON and, by default config, protected by cookie authentication and the auto-generated per-resource 'restful <method> <id>' permission.

There is no support yet for the zone or country field types, only for the address field, since that is the common case. The optional address_decoupled_commerce submodule adds a Commerce-aware variant that returns the current store's shipping/billing supported countries with no store id in the path.
